an7.39:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato Sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.39:1.3: Idha bhikkhave Sāriputto ‘idam me cetaso līnattan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an7.39:1.4: ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘ajjhattaṃ me saṃkhittaṃ cittan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an7.39:1.5: bahiddhā vā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ ‘bahiddhā me vikkhittaṃ cittan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an7.39:1.6: Tassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an7.39:1.7: viditā saññā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti, viditā
an7.39:1.8: vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an7.39:1.9: sappāyāsappāyesu kho pan' assa dhammesu hīnappaṇītesu kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgesu nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
an7.39:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato Sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī
